description: Unified qkv multi-NAP LUT (full 8K run; smoke-tested at n_steps=400 first, ran clean). Replace exp593's separate qk_lut + v_lut with ONE module: H=1, multi-NAP (NAP=4 sub @ tph=256, NAP=6 sub @ tph=320), n_outputs=1152 (= H_attn*(2*d_qk+d_v) = 6*192). Output [B*T, 1, 1152] -> reshape [B*T, H=6, 192] -> slice q[0:64], k[64:128], v[128:192] per head. Single routing pass serves all 6 attention heads AND combines q,k,v projection. All tables contribute to all 1152 outputs. Mixture depth per slot 576 (vs exp593's 256 on q,k and 320 on v). Cost: +104M params, +43% trunk BW. Saves 6x routing work.
